summary: 1. Aug 31 production posts the fiscal cycle's widest daily miss on the total line so far — 16,306 BCM against a 22,992.6 BCM target (-29.08%) — which the day's own tab ties directly to a 3.5-hour blasting delay from a dump-truck breakdown, even as ore beat target for a fourth straight day (+46.9%), narrowing the MTD ore gap to -10.08%. 2. 2. MTD production reaches 131,347 BCM (-12.11% vs target) through day 7 of the 31-day cycle, with 24 fiscal days remaining. 3. 3. Crusher stockpile throughput crosses 15,885 LCM against the 124,000 LCM monthly plan (12.81%) on the cycle's best daily feed yet (3,924 BCM), and overall fleet availability climbs to 86.15% as DT-106's standing tyre fault finally closes with a logged Date Out. 4. Drilling posted its weakest day of the cycle against target on Aug 31 (2,083 m vs a 2,563 m plan, -18.73%) — confirm whether this ties to the same DT breakdown and blasting delay flagged in the production tab's own comment or is an independent drilling-side shortfall. 5. DT-128 has now cycled through three distinct fault descriptions on three consecutive reports (27-Aug engine/camshaft seal, 30-Aug engine low power, 31-Aug hydraulic leak plus engine alarm) — worth a direct workshop check on whether this is one deteriorating issue being rediagnosed each shift or genuinely unrelated faults landing back to back on the same unit. 6. DT-129's transmission fault (No Gear, Trans Tank Empty) went from a report-edge flag on 30-Aug to a full 24-hour down day on 31-Aug — confirm repair timeline with the workshop. 7. Four new files under `Maaden Plans/Mitigation Plan/` and one under `Safety Report/` were found but left for the next full-scope `mining-kb-afternoon-compile` run — out of scope for this dashboard-focused pass, same convention as the 99th pass. 8. Wiki compile: updated [[daily-production-report]] (Aug 31 daily/MTD figures, fourth straight ore beat, widest daily total-line miss of the cycle, crusher stockpile throughput past 15,000 LCM) and [[fleet-availability-utilization]] (Aug 31 fleet-wide and per-unit detail, DT-106 fault closed, DT-128's third fault handoff, DZ-248 new planned outage) — two articles' `Last updated` bumped to 2026-09-01. `Wiki/INDEX.md` one-line descriptions refreshed for both. 9. No content removed or renamed. Source: KNOWLEDGE/mining_operations_kb/RAW via the librarian compile protocol. ---
